content: API Reference. Full reference for PagefindIndex, PagefindRecord, WeightedSegment, PagefindAnchor. PagefindIndex. Main entry point. Call AddRecord then WriteAsync. PagefindRecord. Represents a single indexable document with Url, Title, Content.

Configuration. Configure PagefindIndexOptions: Language, IncludeCharacters, WeightedSegments. Language. Set Language to a BCP-47 language tag such as en. IncludeCharacters. Additional characters to keep during tokenisation.
Getting Started. Welcome to pagefind-net. Install the NuGet package and call WriteAsync. Installation. Run: dotnet add package Pagefind.Net. Quickstart. Create a PagefindIndex and add records.
